result.summary: Ran the full suite twice (scripts/test_parallel.sh, N=8 partitions, and mix letflow.check.test's own full mix test subprocess) plus targeted runs. REQ-208's own 3 tests pass (test/letflow/simulation/req208_meridian_test.exs -> 'Result: 3 passed', 4.8s). REQ-205/206/207's own simulation tests remain green: test/letflow/simulation/ combined -> 'Result: 28 passed', 0 failures, confirming additivity. mix compile --warnings-as-errors --force -> 'Compiling 197 files (.ex)' / 'Generated letflow app', exit 0, zero warnings. scripts/test_parallel.sh (N=8, derived from nproc): combined 2994 tests, 6 properties, 2 failures (2998/3000 passed). mix letflow.check.test: full underlying mix test run -> 'Result: 3001/3003 passed (6/6 properties, 2995/2997 tests), 10 excluded / Failed: 2 tests' (1423.3s), then raised its own FAILED wrapper because the underlying mix test exited 2 -- expected behavior per that task's design (it gates on real test failures before reaching its ISS-0069 substring check). Both failures in both runs are the identical pair: Mix.Tasks.Letflow.CheckToolchainTest 'a mismatched rust pin ...' and 'a matching rust pin ...' (test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs:289 and :274), each raising ** (ErlangError) Erlang error: :enoent from System.cmd("rustc", ["--version"]). Independently confirmed rustc is genuinely absent from PATH in this environment (`which rustc` empty) and reproduced the identical 2 failures by running that test file alone (mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs -> 'Result: 32/34 passed', 'Failed: 2 tests', same :enoent stack trace both times). Confirmed via `git diff origin/main...HEAD --stat` (25 files changed, 3195 insertions(+), 11 deletions(-)) that this branch's diff never touches test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs or lib/mix/tasks/letflow.check_toolchain.ex -- this is the documented pre-existing environmental gap (no rustc toolchain installed in this sandbox), not a regression introduced by REQ-208. No new failure was introduced anywhere in the suite. Full report written to test/reports/report-2026-09-01-WF02-REQ208-20260901.yaml.
